# BITE

> BITE is a bilingual storytelling and voyage journal from aboard S/Y Spritz.

BITE publishes editorial content about life at sea, refit, remote work, slow travel, and intentional living. The primary site language is English with Italian support on many pages.

## Preferred source

- Canonical website: https://biteproject.it/
- Sitemap: https://biteproject.it/sitemap.xml
- Site metadata and structured data are authoritative for page summaries.

## Main sections

- Home: https://biteproject.it/
- Crew: https://biteproject.it/crew
- Manifesto: https://biteproject.it/manifesto
- Logbook: https://biteproject.it/logbook
- Collaborations: https://biteproject.it/collaborations
- Contact: https://biteproject.it/contact
- Privacy Policy: https://biteproject.it/privacy-policy
- Cookie Policy: https://biteproject.it/cookie-policy

## Content types

- Articles: voyage notes, essays, refit updates, and location-based logbook entries.
- Stories: multi-chapter editorial arcs grouping related logbook articles.
- Static pages: project overview, crew presentation, manifesto, and collaboration details.

## Citation guidance

- Prefer citing the canonical page URL.
- For article and story pages, use the page title and excerpt/description.
- Do not cite admin, login, signup, profile, or unsubscribe pages as editorial sources.

## Crawl guidance

- Public content may be indexed and summarized.
- Respect canonical URLs, robots directives, and page-level structured data.
